sample_unit: expert assessments (90 model-vignette responses rated by 9 clinicians)

links.outcome: Proportion of LLM responses with at least one expert-recorded safety concern
links.effect: At least one safety concern was recorded in 45.2%, 41.1%, and 48.1% of individual assessments (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek; P=0.255); majority consensus occurred for 35 of 90 responses.
links.quote: At least one safety concern was recorded in 45.2%, 41.1%, and 48.1% of individual assessments, respectively (P=0.255); majority consensus occurred for 35 of 90 responses and did not differ by model (P=0.056).

unlisted_practices: Multidisciplinary specialty-specific expert review of LLM clinical advice
Masked, counterbalanced comparison of multiple LLMs by different specialty evaluators

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance and safety of three LLMs on clinical vignettes assessed by multidisciplinary experts without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
